embeds.title: 🔴 AI Agent Finds 18-Year-Old Remote Code Execution Flaw in Nginx
embeds.description:
Researchers from DepthFirst AI discovered CVE-2026-42945, a critical heap buffer overflow vulnerability in Nginx web server that has remained undetected for 18 years. The flaw is located in ngx_http_rewrite_module and affects Nginx versions 0.6.27 to 1.30.0 with a CVSS score of 9.2. F5's Nginx Plus and multiple F5 products are also vulnerable. The vulnerability can lead to denial of service and potentially remote code execution on systems with ASLR disabled. DepthFirst researchers believe RCE is achievable by leveraging Nginx's multi-process architecture to bypass ASLR. Three additional vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-42946, CVE-2026-42934, CVE-2026-40701) were also discovered and patched.
**Sources:** CSO Online • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-42945, CVE-2026-42946, CVE-2026-42934, CVE-2026-40701 • **Access:** n/a
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** claim
